Discord has a highly engaged community of millions of daily active users who use the platform for many different reasons, but there’s one thing that nearly everyone does: play video games. Discord plays a uniquely important role in the future of gaming, and we are focused on making it easier and more fun for people to hang out before, during, and after playing games.

We're seeking a strategic Staff Product Marketing Manager to build and lead the go-to-market strategy for Discord's Unified Developer Platform, focused on helping game developers and publishers build richer social experiences, grow their communities, and deepen player engagement through Discord's platform.

You'll drive product adoption by building robust go-to-market and Business Development enablement programs, defining activation goals, and partnering closely with Business Development, Developer Operations, Product, and Developer Relations to successfully bring new platform capabilities to market. This role will play a key part in accelerating adoption of Discord's Unified Developer Platform across the Gaming industry.

If you're a self-starter and team player who excels in fast-paced environments and zero to scale projects, this is a unique opportunity to make a significant impact on Discord's developer ecosystem and shape the future of our platform business. We're looking for an experienced, strategic PMM who is passionate about developers, gaming, and building products that enable partners to succeed.

What You'll Be Doing

· Develop and execute go-to-market strategies for Discord's developer platform through market research, customer segmentation, competitive analysis, and targeted programs that drive developer awareness, adoption, and long-term platform growth.

· Lead activation initiatives across Discord's platform portfolio by crafting differentiated messaging, value propositions, positioning, and go-to-market motions that resonate with game developers and publishers.

· Build and scale impactful Business Development and Developer Operations enablement programs—including training, playbooks, product collateral, competitive positioning, implementation guidance, objection handling, and customer-facing tools—to empower internal teams to successfully bring Discord's platform to market.

· Define and track platform adoption goals, activation KPIs, and business metrics, continuously refining go-to-market strategies to improve developer adoption and create scalable, repeatable growth.

· Act as the voice of developers and strategic partners, translating customer insights into actionable recommendations that influence product strategy, roadmap prioritization, positioning, and future platform investments.

· Partner with Business Marketing, Developer Relations, and Communications to establish Discord's thought leadership within the gaming developer ecosystem through industry events, customer stories, technical content, and strategic partnerships.

· Lead cross-functional go-to-market planning and execution across Product Management, Engineering, Business Development, Developer Operations, Developer Relations, Marketing, Design, and Legal to ensure successful product launches and organizational readiness.

What you should have

· 7+ years of Product Marketing experience in B2B technology, gaming, developer platforms, SaaS, APIs, SDKs, or platform businesses.

· Experience developing and executing go-to-market strategies for technical products and driving adoption through Business Development, Partnerships, or other customer-facing teams.

· Experience building scalable enablement programs, including messaging, positioning, launch materials, training, playbooks, and customer collateral.

· Strong understanding of developer ecosystems, technical audiences, and how to translate complex platform capabilities into compelling customer value propositions.

· Excellent strategic thinking, communication, and storytelling skills with the ability to influence cross-functional teams and executive stakeholders.

· Experience working in ambiguous, fast-moving environments and excitement for building new products, business models, and go-to-market motions from the ground up.

· Passion for gaming, developers, and helping partners build successful communities on Discord.

Candidates must reside in or be willing to relocate to the San Francisco Bay Area (Alameda, Contra Costa, Marin, Napa, San Francisco, San Mateo, Santa Clara, Solano, and Sonoma counties). Relocation assistance may be available.

The US base salary range for this full-time position is $204,000 to $229,000 + equity + benefits. Our salary ranges are determined by role and level. Within the range, individual pay is determined by additional factors, including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training. Please note that the compensation details listed in US role postings reflect the base salary only, and do not include equity, or benefits.

Why Discord?

Discord plays a uniquely important role in the future of gaming. We're a multiplatform, multigenerational and multiplayer platform that helps people deepen their friendships around games and shared interests, and helps developers build and grow their businesses. We believe games give us a way to have fun with our favorite people, whether listening to music together or grinding in competitive matches for diamond rank. Join us in our mission! Your future is just a click away!

Brex is the intelligent finance platform that enables companies to spend smarter and move faster in more than 200 markets.

By combining global corporate cards and banking with intuitive spend management, bill pay, and travel software, Brex enables founders and finance teams to accelerate operations, gain real-time visibility, and control spend effortlessly.

Brex’s AI-native automation and world-class service eliminate manual expense and accounting tasks for customers so they can focus on what matters most. Tens of thousands of the world's best companies run on Brex, including DoorDash, Coinbase, Robinhood, Zoom, Plaid, Reddit, and SeatGeek.

Working at Brex allows you to push your limits, challenge the status quo, and collaborate with some of the brightest minds in the industry. We’re committed to building a diverse team and inclusive culture and believe your potential should only be limited by how big you can dream. We make this a reality by empowering you with the tools, resources, and support you need to grow your career.

Marketing at Brex

The Marketing team tells the Brex story, determines messaging and positioning, and translates our products and features into tangible customer benefits. Our marketers, across Revenue Marketing, Product Marketing, and Brand Marketing, are responsible for acquiring new customers and have a deep understanding of the business.

We're a highly cross-functional team and partner most closely with Product, Sales, and Business Development to show our prospects and customers how we can help them reach their full potential.

As an Event Marketing Manager at Brex, you’ll support a portfolio of B2B events - the events that put us in front of founders, finance leaders, and operators. You'll report to the Head of Events on the Corporate Events team in Revenue Marketing, and work daily with sales, field marketing, and brand design.

Corporate Events is a growing team that delivers highly engaging, high quality events with consistent ROI. You'll deliver a portfolio of industry & hosted events from brief through post-event reporting. You'll have input on the portfolio strategy and how the team operates.

The work spans strategy, operations, experience design with our brand and creative teams, and tight coordination with sales on what happens before and after each event.

Where you’ll work

This role will be based in one of our 5 hubs (San Francisco, New York City, Seattle, Salt Lake City and Vancouver). We are a hybrid environment that combines the energy and connections of being in the office with the benefits and flexibility of working from home. We currently require a minimum of three coordinated days in the office per week, Monday, Wednesday and Thursday. As a perk, we also have up to four weeks per year of fully remote work!

Like every team at OpenAI, the Marketing team contributes to our broader mission of ensuring responsible and widespread adoption of artificial intelligence. With that aim in mind, we are responsible for developing and executing strategies that drive awareness, engagement, and usage for OpenAI’s products and platform amongst our core audiences.

We take a data-driven approach to understand our customers' needs and challenges, ensuring that their voices are reflected in product development and messaging. We then partner closely with Product, Engineering, Research, Comms, and Design teams to create a cohesive customer experience across all our channels.

Our focus extends beyond just promoting product features; we aim to provide valuable insights and resources that help our users make the most out of AI technologies.

We are seeking a Government Marketing Manager to lead marketing campaigns and programs for OpenAI’s government business, OpenAI for Government. This role will define how we communicate the impact of our work with governments and public institutions, turning technical products and partnership outcomes into clear stories that show how AI can help public servants better serve people and communities.
The ideal candidate has experience working with government entities and leading in complex, multi-stakeholder environments. They bring strong strategic and creative judgment, translate technology and policy priorities for diverse audiences, and build trust and engagement across paid, owned, and earned channels.

Build the OpenAI for Government Narrative and Brand: Build a distinct government narrative aligned with the OpenAI brand, centered on mission outcomes, public servants, security, and responsible deployment.
Build a Government Storytelling Engine: Create a repeatable process to source, prioritize, approve, and refresh customer stories, public use cases, metrics, and quotes for web, video, social, sales, events, and internal storytelling.
Lead Product Release Marketing: Build marketing plans for government-relevant product releases, security and compliance milestones, partnerships, projects, and other key moments.
Shape OpenAI for Government’s Presence: Define how and when OpenAI shows up at conferences, summits, think tanks, and public events relevant to government audiences, turning marquee moments into sustained relationships and pipeline, in collaboration with the internal events team.
Develop Segment and Mission Campaigns: Turn OpenAI for Government’s priority audience segments into campaigns for relevant agencies and mission sets. Develop reusable content for government and partner audiences such as white papers, executive and solution briefs, use-case playbooks, videos, and decks.
Lead Partner Marketing Campaigns: Develop and execute joint campaigns with strategic partners, align go-to-market plans, amplify shared announcements, and strengthen OpenAI for Government’s position in priority markets.
Develop and maintain government-focused demo materials: Partner with Government Solutions Engineering to maintain demos that bring priority mission workflows and product capabilities to life.
Drive Action-Oriented Engagement: Generate qualified interest and pipeline while advancing thought leadership and community engagement. Define success metrics and use insights to improve performance.
Lead Cross-Functional Execution: Bring together government stakeholders, OpenAI for Government, Global Affairs, Communications, Product, Legal, Policy, regional and creative teams, and agencies to move programs from brief through approval, launch, and measurement.

Du baust smarte Kampagnen und Flows, die mehr sind als übliche 08/15 Gedöns. Von personalisierten E-Mails über WhatsApp bis hin zu Print Mailings wird alles mal dabei sein. Dein Fokus liegt aber ganz klar im Bereich E-Mail Marketing, den Rest können wir Dir auch gerne beibringen.

Wir möchten sicherstellen, dass Du perfekt zu uns passt und wir zu Dir! Deshalb haben wir einen transparenten und fairen Bewerbungsprozess, der uns die Möglichkeit gibt, Dich besser kennenzulernen und Dir gleichzeitig einen guten Einblick in unsere Arbeitsweise zu geben. Hier sind die einzelnen Schritte:
Schick uns Deine Bewerbung inklusive Lebenslauf, kleinem Motivationsschreiben und Arbeitsproben (falls vorhanden).
Wir prüfen Deine Bewerbung und bewerten, ob Deine Erfahrungen und Fähigkeiten zu unseren Anforderungen passen. Wir melden uns in der Regel innerhalb von maximal 3 Werktagen bei Dir.
Wenn uns Deine Bewerbung überzeugt, laden wir Dich zu einem ca. 30-minütigen Video-Call ein. Ziel ist es, Dich persönlich kennenzulernen, mehr über Deine Motivation zu erfahren und Dir gleichzeitig mehr über uns, unser Team und unsere Arbeitsweise zu erzählen.
Um Dein Können besser einschätzen zu können, bitten wir Dich ggf. im Anschluss nach dem Call noch um eine kurze Testaufgabe. Diese Aufgabe simuliert typische Projekte aus unserem Arbeitsalltag. Du hast genug Zeit, sie in Ruhe in den nächsten Tagen zu bearbeiten.
In einem zweiten Gespräch besprechen wir die Ergebnisse der Testaufgabe, klären offene Fragen und vertiefen bestimmte Themen – seien es Fragen zu Deiner Arbeitsweise, Deine Wünsche an uns oder unsere Erwartungen an Dich.
Wenn beide Seiten ein gutes Gefühl haben, senden wir Dir ein verbindliches Angebot zu. Sobald Du zustimmst, starten wir gemeinsam durch!
Hast Du noch Fragen? Wir stehen Dir gerne zur Verfügung. Schreib uns einfach an.
Wir freuen uns darauf, Dich kennenzulernen und gemeinsam mit Dir die Zukunft des E-Mail- und WhatsApp-Marketings zu gestalten!
